mapper.select: SELECT plan.id, plan.NAME, COUNT( planBatch.id ) AS batchCount, COUNT( measureBatch.id ) AS measureCount FROM bm_liquid_preparation_plan plan LEFT JOIN bm_liquid_preparation_plan_material_batch planBatch ON plan.id = planBatch.liquid_preparation_plan_id AND planBatch.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_liquid_preparation_measure_batch measureBatch ON measureBatch.liquid_preparation_plan_batch_id = planBatch.id WHERE plan.completed = TRUE AND plan.is_deleted = 0 AND plan.product_plan_id = #{productPlanId} GROUP BY plan.id ORDER BY plan.NAME
